units: <cite ref="Shabbat 6a:11">Sabb. 6ᵃ</cite> <he>ס׳ ופלטיא וכ׳</he> a camp and a large highway. (<cite ref="Shabbat 151a">Ib. 151ᵃ</cite> <cite ref="A02560"><he>אִסְרַטְיָא</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Eruvin 22b:19">Erub. 22ᵇ</cite> <he>תיקן להם דרכים וס׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>אִסְטְרַטְיָאוֹת</he>; ed. Sonc. <he>סרַטְיוֹת</he>) (Joshua) made for them roads with stations.—Pl. <he>סְרַטְיָאוֹת</he>, <he>סְרַטְיוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 2:5">Tosef. Ab. Zar. II, 5</cite> <he>העולה לסרטאיות של גויים</he> (ed. Zuck. <he>לתרטאי׳</he>; corr. acc.) he who visits gentile camps (for entertainments).

<cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 2:7">Ib. 7</cite> <he>להעולה לתרטייאות … היה ציירו וכ׳</he> ed. Zuck. (corr. <he>לסרט׳</he>, and strike out <cite ref="E00230"><he>היה</he></cite>; oth. ed. <he>לסרטאות … אם צווח</he>, corr. acc.) he who enters Roman camps (joins the Romans in besieging a Jewish city), if they undertake the siege for the benefit of the country &c., v. <cite ref="H01806"><he>חָשַׁב</he></cite> (v.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 18b:6">Ab. Zar. 18ᵇ</cite> <he>ולכרקום מותר</he>); Y. ib. I, 40ᵇ <he>העולה לתיאטרון וצווח</he> (read: <he>לס׳ וצייר</he>).
